reader_exposure_measure.definition: Discover first 120 served items per daily slate, expanding bundles to member futures IDs, weighted by distinct days appeared (1..14).
reader_exposure_measure.search_note: Search half omitted in v1 because search_query_logs does not store returned futures market IDs and reader search text stays unread (#13898). Next quarterly refresh adds search weights once search logs returned market IDs.

quarterly_refresh_rule: Each quarter, retire the third of the sealed set (100 markets) that has been settled longest (by settled_at, then resolution_date) and draw replacements from non-pilot, non-sealed open markets using a newly posted seed.
